newsitem.title: USA: Buenos Aires Embotelladora faces lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Buenos Aires Embotelladora faces lawsuit.

text.p: Lawyers on behalf of a class of purchasers of American Depository Shares and bonds of Buenos Aires Embotelladora SA said Thursday that they had filed a class action lawsuit against the company.

A release issued Thursday from law firms Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP and Catanzarite Law Corp said that the class action was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York for plaintiffs who purchased ADS's or bonds between November 16, 1995 and July 2, 1996.

Lawyers for the plaintiffs said that the complaint charges the company, PepsiCo Inc and Charles H. Beach with misrepresenting the financial condition of Buenos Aires Embotelladora and failing to disclose operational problems affecting the company.
Charles Beach was formerly chief executive officer for Buenos Aires Embotelladora.

The lawyers alleged in the release that due to the issuance of a series of "false and misleading" financial statements, the prices of the company's ADS's and bonds were "artificially inflated" during the class period.
Buenos Aires Embotelladora was not immediately available for comment.
A representative at PepsiCo said a copy of alleged charges had not yet reached the company late Thursday morning.
